texts.name: The Crown of the Wood
texts.blurb: Where the wood ends, the fire it was planted against.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every 102 seconds roots close 4 ways and open 4 others. A green glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks. Two wisps are bound in it, and Ash and Ember wait at its heart, far to the north. Free the wisps, cut the roots that feed them, and their door opens.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: The paths move, but my lamps stay put. Mostly.

people.name: The Kiln-Mother
greet: You found the charcoal clearing? Then you can stand by it a while.

people.name: The Charm-Pedlar
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Heart of the Wood
intro: Clear the hounds’ den, and its wisp follows you: lead it to the heart. Then the old stones: the Stag-Crowned guards the second wisp. Last, cut the three roots that feed Ash and Ember, and their door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. Ash and Ember’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the hounds’ den to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the old stones to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the heart
Go to Ash and Ember’s door

quests.name: Grandmother Thorn
intro: Grandmother Thorn walks round the old oak. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from the old wood. Keep it.

quests.name: The Hollow Hunter
intro: The Hollow Hunter walks the far glades. Nobody lights the lamps while it does.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps: one at the lantern shrine, one at the mossy spring. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see the paths move.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the moss.

quests.name: The Lost Spade
intro: Linden dropped a spade in the dark thicket and will not go back for it. Carry it to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.

steps.text: Bring the spade from the dark thicket to the fire

quests.name: The Burners’ Watch
intro: My stacks lie past the charcoal clearing. Find them, then hold the clearing while I bring the charcoal in: the hounds smell the smoke.
outro: All in, and dry. Take this.

steps.text: Hold the clearing while the charcoal comes in

doors.name: The Cinder Court
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once Ash and Ember has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Anka. Walk into the thicket behind me and we see who is better. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: Something lives in it that is older still.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

named1.name: Grandmother Thorn
named1.blurb: Walks round the old oak and strikes hard.

named2.name: The Hollow Hunter
named2.blurb: Walks the far glades and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the heart. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: Ash and Ember
ruler.title: The fire at the wood’s end
ruler.line: A Raid boss, alone: two of them, fire and ash; keep moving
